responseText: Our main goal is to reach and secure Hammer Rest, a larger settlement we're trying to establish further in. But the direct route, the Old King's Road, is becoming a chokepoint. Gretta Ironhand, one of our sharpest, has established a forward observation post, Gritstone Overwatch, along that road. She just sent word: a large number of these Clay Dwarves are gathering near her, showing a new level of aggression and... organization. She needs support, urgently. Get to her. She'll know how to direct you.
name: ANV_FTUE_Dunir_GatewatcherStonebeard_12_Response
